cases.title: Invoice paid in part, then in full
cases.description: Create and post an invoice, apply a partial payment and check the balance, then apply the remainder.
cases.expectedResult: The balance falls after each payment, and the invoice shows as paid in the customer account and the receipts register.

cases.title: Same ID as the first case
cases.description: Create and post an invoice, apply a partial payment and check the balance, then apply the remainder.
cases.expectedResult: The balance falls after each payment, and the invoice shows as paid in the customer account and the receipts register.

cases.title: Credit note against an invoice
cases.description: Issue a credit note for part of a posted invoice and apply it.

cases.title: Tax and rounding on a multi-line invoice
cases.description: Enter an invoice with many small lines, a mix of taxable and exempt items, and a discount. Compare line-level and invoice-level tax.
cases.expectedResult: Tax follows the documented rounding rule, and the total equals the sum of its parts to the cent.
